---
title: "phibble"
subtitle: "A typed data frame for PHP"
---

phibble is a data frame library for PHP. A `DataFrame` is a table of named,
typed columns, such as the rows of a CSV file or a database query. phibble
reads such tables, filters, sorts, groups, joins, and summarizes them, and
writes them back out. Its design and names follow R's tibble and readr
packages, and its verbs follow dplyr.

{{< include examples/_tour.md >}}

## Tables

- Every column has one type: float, int, bool, string, factor, date, datetime,
  or list. Types are guessed as a table loads, or declared per column.
- PHP `null` is a missing value (R's NA) in every type.
- A `DataFrame` never changes in place. Every method returns a new table.
- Tables load from CSV, JSON, PDO queries, Laravel and Doctrine query
  builders, and Laravel collections, and write to CSV and JSON.

The [types guide](types.qmd) and [reading and writing data](io.qmd) cover
these in detail.

## Backends

Three classes implement the `Phibble\Contracts\Table` interface, and all
three are part of phibble:

- `Phibble\DataFrame` holds the data in PHP arrays.
- `Phibble\Sql\SqlTable` compiles the verbs to SQL for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and
  MySQL.
- `Phibble\Polars\PolarsTable` runs the verbs in Polars. It needs the
  php_polars extension from [phpolars](https://github.com/phpstats/phpolars).

A step that a backend cannot run itself, such as a PHP closure, runs in a
`DataFrame`. The [backends page](backends.qmd) describes how results can
still differ between backends.

## Other packages

The other PHPstats packages read and return phibble tables:

- [phplyr](https://github.com/phpstats/phplyr) provides dplyr and tidyr as
  PHP functions and method chains.
- [phit](https://github.com/phpstats/phit) fits statistical models, reading
  their data through `DataFrame::toModelData()`. Its extension also speeds up
  phibble's CSV reader.
- [phpolars](https://github.com/phpstats/phpolars) provides the Polars
  extension that `PolarsTable` uses.
- [phiz](https://github.com/phpstats/phiz) plots a `DataFrame` directly.
- [CmdStanPHP](https://github.com/phpstats/CmdStanPHP) accepts a `DataFrame`
  as model data and returns draws and summaries as tables.

## Install

```bash
composer require phpstats/phibble
```

Requirements:

- PHP 8.3 or later. `composer.json` allows `^8.3`, and CI tests PHP 8.3, 8.4,
  and 8.5.
- The PDO extension.

Optional:

- The phit extension reads CSV natively. `fromCsv()` uses phit 0.1.1 or
  later, and the chunked readers use phit 0.2.0 or later.
- The php_polars extension enables `PolarsTable`.
- `illuminate/database` enables the Laravel macros.

Pipelines can use PHP 8.5's `|>` operator. Method chains work on every
supported version.
